n242.name: mainTheorem_general
n242.type_full:
∀ {N : Nat} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter Complex N} {t : Real},
  Or (Ne (HPow.hPow χ 2) 1) (Ne t 0) → Ne (χ.LFunction (HAdd.hAdd 1 (HMul.hMul Complex.I ↑t))) 0

n243.name: ArithmeticFunction.iteratedDeriv_LSeries_alternating
n243.type_full:
∀ (a : ArithmeticFunction Complex),
  (∀ (n : Nat), LE.le 0 (a n)) →
    ∀ {x : Real},
      LT.lt (LSeries.abscissaOfAbsConv fun x => a x) ↑x →
        ∀ (n : Nat), LE.le 0 (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow (-1) n) (iteratedDeriv n (LSeries fun x => a x) ↑x))

n244.name: Complex.apply_le_of_iteratedDeriv_alternating
n244.type_full:
∀ {f : Complex → Complex} {s : Complex},
  Differentiable Complex f →
    (∀ (n : Nat), Ne n 0 → LE.le 0 (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow (-1) n) (iteratedDeriv n f s))) →
      ∀ {z : Complex}, LE.le z s → LE.le (f s) (f z)

n245.name: norm_dirichlet_product_ge_one
n245.type_full:
∀ {N : Nat} (χ : DirichletCharacter Complex N) {x : Real},
  LT.lt 0 x →
    ∀ (y : Real),
      GE.ge
        (norm
          (HMul.hMul
            (HMul.hMul (HPow.hPow (LSeries (fun n => 1 ↑n) (HAdd.hAdd 1 ↑x)) 3)
              (HPow.hPow (LSeries (fun n => χ ↑n) (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd 1 ↑x) (HMul.hMul Complex.I ↑y))) 4))
            (LSeries (fun n => (HPow.hPow χ 2) ↑n)
              (HAdd.hAdd (HAdd.hAdd 1 ↑x) (HMul.hMul (HMul.hMul 2 Complex.I) ↑y)))))
        1

n246.name: mainTheorem_quadratic
n246.type_full: ∀ {N : Nat} [inst : NeZero N] {χ : DirichletCharacter Complex N}, Eq (HPow.hPow χ 2) 1 → Ne χ 1 → Ne (χ.LFunction 1) 0

n247.name: ourMainTheorem
n247.type_full:
∀ {N : Nat} [inst : NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter Complex N) (t : Real),
  Or (Ne χ 1) (Ne t 0) → Ne (χ.LFunction (HAdd.hAdd 1 (HMul.hMul Complex.I ↑t))) 0
